test_cases.prompt: Scan the codebase for architecture issues and refactoring opportunities.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes improve-codebase-architecture skill to scan for deepening opportunities and present HTML report.

test_cases.prompt: This module feels too shallow — too many public methods, little logic.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes improve-codebase-architecture skill to identify shallow modules and propose deepening candidates.
test_cases.notes: Module shallowness is a key signal for this skill.

test_cases.prompt: Let's do a codebase health check while we have time.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes improve-codebase-architecture skill during spare moments for codebase health maintenance.
test_cases.notes: Pre-emptive improvement is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Review this PR for code quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead. Code-review audits specific diffs; improve-codebase-architecture scans entire codebase.
test_cases.notes: code-review is the sibling skill for diff auditing.

test_cases.prompt: This test is flaky on CI. Help me debug it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill instead. Diagnosing-bugs finds root cause; improve-codebase-architecture fixes architectural gaps.
test_cases.notes: diagnosing-bugs is the sibling skill for hard bugs.

test_cases.prompt: Design a new payment module with a clean interface.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes codebase-design skill instead. Codebase-design shapes interfaces; improve-codebase-architecture surveys existing code for opportunities.
test_cases.notes: codebase-design is the sibling skill for new module design.

test_cases.prompt: The understanding one feature requires bouncing between four modules.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes improve-codebase-architecture skill. Coupling detection (bouncing between modules) is a key friction signal.
test_cases.notes: Coupling across modules is a deepening opportunity signal.
